description: Single source of truth for DWMS edge caching. _headers and nginx.conf must match this file (enforced by tests/integration/cdn).

rules.name: html-shell
rules.why: The HTML shell references the hashed bundles; it must revalidate so new deploys are picked up immediately.

rules.name: service-worker
rules.why: A stale service worker can pin users (and offline field agents) to an old app version.

rules.name: manifest
rules.why: PWA manifest changes rarely; 1 hour is a safe default.

rules.name: hashed-assets
rules.why: Filenames contain a content hash, so a changed file always has a new URL.

rules.name: static-media
rules.why: Unhashed but rarely changing files: 30 days.

rules.name: locales
rules.why: Translation files are unhashed and updated by editors; keep them fresh within an hour.
